data.title: 玛修 · 食堂午餐
data.description: 【玛修 · 食堂午餐】迦勒底食堂的午间，玛修端着盛满的餐盘找到座位，灰色外套搭在椅背，她认真地把蔬菜和肉排分开摆好，粉发刘海下的紫瞳亮晶晶——「前辈，今天食堂的炖菜很好吃哦。」
data.action: 坐好后将灰外套搭在椅背，一手扶餐盘，另一手把肉排与蔬菜分开摆好
data.camera: medium shot, sitting at dining table
data.promptProse: Mash steadies her lunch tray with one hand and separates vegetables from the meat cutlet with a fork in the other. Her grey jacket lies over the chair back, leaving black collared dress, red necktie and glasses visible as she looks up contentedly. The medium view includes a stew bowl and cafeteria tables behind. Midday window light reaches her pink-lavender fringe and plate, casting small fork and tray shadows across the table.
